title: Viewing Immutable Statutory Drug Registers (H, H1, X, Narcotics)

intro.title: Statutory Drug Registers
intro.subtitle: Form 35 Schedule H1, Schedule H, Schedule X psychotropics, and NDPS narcotics registers with tamper-evident audit trails

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 3, Part 5: Viewing Immutable Statutory Drug Registers. Under Indian Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, pharmacies must maintain strict, tamper-evident registers for controlled substances.
Open Compliance to access your registers. The Schedule H1 tab automatically catalogs Form 35 entries including 3rd generation cephalosporins and anti-TB drugs, locked for 3-year statutory retention.
Switch to Schedule H to monitor everyday prescription medicine dispenses, displaying patient identity, registered prescriber details, and doctor registration numbers.
Click NDPS Narcotics or Schedule X to review heavily monitored psychotropic substances, with exact quantities dispensed and strict invoice linkages.
Filter transactions by date range or search by patient name to verify any supply instant. In Part 6, learn how to print inspector-ready statutory registers.

outro.takeaway: Statutory Drug Registers: Maintain tamper-evident, separate registers for Schedule H1, H, X, and NDPS narcotics with automated 3-year retention compliance.
